Callout.Name: Pursuit in Progress
Callout.Message: Vehicle failing to stop, pursuit not yet authorised.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle heading west at speed, driver not identified.

Script.Line: It is the second time tonight it has gone past here.
Same plate, same driver. He is doing laps.
Do what you have to do. I am not going anywhere.

Lines.Approach: They are not stopping and they are going west. Call it in before you commit.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
